name: Efface Touch
description: Efface a hostile soul mark with a touch of its mirror before it can set.

name: Nil Reading
description: Read the nil point of a hostile soul force to learn where it will cancel itself.

name: Abating Guard
description: Hold a guard that abates each hostile soul push by half before it reaches the mind.

name: Mirrored Abate
description: Abate a hostile soul wave by sounding its mirror against it until both subside.

name: Expunge Taint
description: Expunge a hostile taint from the soul of an ally with the mirror of its own shape.

name: Quiet Easing
description: Ease the wounded soul of an ally with a deep quiet that cancels the pain in it.

name: Rescinded Blow
description: Rescind a foe's soul blow in the act of its landing so that it arrives with no weight.

name: Nil Pillar
description: Raise a pillar of nil about the user that cancels every hostile soul force which touches it.

name: Mirrored Rebuke
description: Rebuke a hostile soul strike with its mirror so that the caster receives their own blow.

name: Grand Efface
description: Efface every hostile soul technique within a great circle at once with the mirror of the field.

name: Mirror Quiet
description: Spread the mirrored quiet of the school over a company with a reach and hold set by the soul of the master.

name: Company Nil
description: Cancel a hostile soul note aimed at the company with the matching quiet of the user.

name: Company Gauge
description: Gauge how steadily each member of the company holds the quiet and who is about to slip.

name: Quieted Screen
description: Draw a screen of quiet across the front of the company that smothers a hostile soul wave.

name: Company Abate
description: Abate a hostile soul surge over the whole company by sharing one cancelling quiet among them.

name: Company Absolve
description: Absolve several allies of a soul curse at once with a quiet shared among them.

name: Company Stanch
description: Stanch the flow of soul force from a foe rank until its techniques run thin.

name: Doubled Quiescence
description: Hold quiescence in two layers over the company so that hostile soul force dies in the first or the second.

name: Answering Quiet
description: Answer a hostile soul strike with a quiet that carries it back on the one who sent it.

name: Great Quiescence
description: Bring a great quiescence down on the field so that all hostile soul force within it ceases.

name: Quieted Company
description: Quiet an entire company against soul attack with a hold that follows the soul of the master.

name: Crown Nil
description: Cancel a hostile soul note beneath the crown of silence before it can sound.

name: Zenith Gauge
description: Gauge the clarity of the sky of silence about the user and find any flaw in it.

name: Silent Aegis
description: Hold a silent aegis over the head and shoulders that turns hostile soul force aside.

name: Crown Easing
description: Ease the soul of a wounded ally beneath the crown of silence until its pain falls quiet.

name: Crowned Abate
description: Abate a hostile soul surge beneath the crown until it has no force left to give.

name: Crown Absolve
description: Absolve an ally of a lingering soul curse by drawing them under the crown of silence.

name: Crown Stanch
description: Stanch the soul force of a foe beneath the crown until their technique cannot rise.

name: Crowned Mending
description: Mend the torn soul of an ally beneath the crown by cancelling each hostile mark in turn.

name: Crown Quiescence
description: Rest a perfect quiescence on the Core so that no hostile soul force can pass beneath the crown.

name: Crown Rebuke
description: Rebuke a hostile soul strike beneath the crown and return it with the sky's own calm.

name: Crown Efface
description: Efface all hostile soul force within the reach of the crown in one unbroken breath.

name: Hushed Crown
description: Crown the master in a hush of silence whose hold and reach follow the strength of the formed Core.

name: Oath Nil
description: Cancel a hostile soul note by speaking the oath of quiet in the mind.

name: Wind Measure
description: Gauge the strength of a hostile soul force by the way it bends the wind of quiet.

name: Breeze Curtain
description: Raise a screen of drifting calm round the user that turns a hostile soul push aside.

name: Oath Abate
description: Abate a hostile soul wave by holding the oath of quiet before it until it sinks.

name: Oath Expunge
description: Expunge a hostile mark from the soul of a comrade by swearing the quiet over it.

name: Gale Stanch
description: Stanch a foe's soul technique with a cold gale of quiet that leaves it no force.

name: Sworn Quiescence
description: Hold a sworn quiescence over the master so that hostile soul force fades before it can strike.

name: Gale Rescind
description: Rescind a hostile soul strike on the wind and send its force back toward the caster.

name: Oath Efface
description: Efface every hostile soul technique across the open field with the sworn word of quiet.

name: Sworn Hush
description: Swear the school hush over a company with a reach and hold set by the soul of the master.

name: Held Nil
description: Cancel a hostile soul note and hold the cancelled place empty for one more beat.

name: Still Gauge
description: Gauge how long the stillness of the user can hold against the weight of a hostile force.

name: Holding Screen
description: Keep a screen of held calm before the mind that does not thin under repeated blows.

name: Held Abate
description: Abate a hostile soul force over a long count by holding the stillness steady against it.

name: Held Absolve
description: Absolve an ally of a soul curse by holding the stillness over them until it lets go.

name: Held Mending
description: Hold a mending stillness over a hurt ally until the torn places close of their own.

name: Held Stanch
description: Hold a foe's soul technique stanched until the foe gives up the attempt.

name: Long Quiescence
description: Hold a long quiescence through a drawn-out clash until the hostile force has no breath left.

name: Held Return
description: Hold a hostile soul strike in stillness and release it back at the caster all at once.

name: Endless Efface
description: Efface hostile soul force across the field without pause for as long as the stillness holds.

name: Stillness Hold
description: Hold the school stillness over a company with a length and strength set by the master's soul.

name: Bare Nil
description: Cancel a hostile soul note in the open with no cover but the user's own stillness.

name: Bare Gauge
description: Gauge the weight of a hostile soul force across an open field before it arrives.

name: Bare Aegis
description: Draw a bare screen of stillness that asks for no cover and gives way to nothing.

name: Bare Abate
description: Abate a hostile soul surge in the open by meeting its whole width with stillness.

name: Bare Absolve
description: Absolve a comrade of a soul affliction in the open with a plain bare stillness.

name: Bare Stanch
description: Stanch a foe's soul technique in the open before it has gathered any strength.

name: Bare Quiescence
description: Rest a bare quiescence on the Core so that hostile soul force meets nothing it can move.

name: Bare Rebuke
description: Rebuke a hostile soul strike in the open and return it unchanged to its sender.

name: Bare Efface
description: Efface hostile soul force over a wide open field with nothing but the stillness of the user.

name: Open Wind Hush
description: Spread the school hush beneath the open wind with a hold set by the formed Core of the master.
